guidelines_reference: WHO 2025 PPH Recommendations, E-MOTIVE Trial (Brizuela et al.), El Ayadi et al. Shock Index Thresholds, India NHM/RHS Standards

alert.action: Increase monitoring to every 5-15 mins. Prepare IV access and alert attending medical officer.

urgent.action: Trigger Obstetric Rapid Response Team. Rapid IV fluid bolus, prepare blood products.

critical.action: Immediate Massive Transfusion Protocol (MTP), apply NASG, emergency surgical intervention.

blood_loss_triggers.who_early_action_rule: 300 mL blood loss combined with any abnormal vital sign (Shock Index >= 0.9, SBP <= 90, or Pulse >= 100) triggers immediate early PPH first-line bundle.

first_line_bundle.name: Oxytocin
first_line_bundle.hindi: ऑक्सीटोसिन 10-20 IU जांघ में या ड्रिप में दें

first_line_bundle.name: Tranexamic Acid (TXA)
first_line_bundle.hindi: ट्रैनेक्सैमिक एसिड 1g IV सुई से धीरे-धीरे दें

first_line_bundle.name: Bimanual Uterine Massage
first_line_bundle.hindi: पेट पर गर्भाशय की लगातार मालिश जारी रखें

first_line_bundle.name: IV Fluid Resuscitation
first_line_bundle.dose: Two 16G large-bore cannulae with Normal Saline
first_line_bundle.hindi: दो 16G मोटी सुई से नॉर्मल सलाइन ड्रिप चालू करें

facility_routing_weights.description: Multi-criteria decision routing for rural obstetric emergencies
